test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **does**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct option is ""does"" because it agrees with the singular subject ""question"" and is in the **present tense**.
 
• ""Do"" and ""done"" are incorrect because they are not in agreement with the subject and ""should"" is incorrect because it does not make sense in the context of the sentence. Grammatically, the verb must agree with the subject in number and tense."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **does**.
